claims.standing_hypotheses: Rains smooth rational elliptic category and existing boundary-disjoint root sheaves; section ring and natural Phi defined under the manuscript's noetherian/chi assumptions. New finite-length and A2 results assume q nontorsion, H=-K nef with H^2>0, and exceptional structure line bundle e.
claims.sign_trichotomy: For an existing irreducible root sheaf: h0=max(m,0), h1=max(-m,0), h2=0; spherical. Numerical resonance alone does not establish existence.
claims.offboundary_category: Under the new hypotheses Z is a finite-length Serre subcategory; no nonzero boundary-disjoint zero-dimensional quotient; irreducible boundary-disjoint root sheaves are simple in the ambient heart. At maximal resonance the r existing simple-root sheaves exhaust its simples.
claims.connecting_rank: For adjacent existing roots of indices p and -(p-1), p>=2, the nonsplit extension P has h0=1,h1=0 and connecting rank p-1. In the explicit +2/-1 example the rank is 1, proved without assuming derived full faithfulness.
claims.mixed_category: The Serre subcategory generated by the two roots is mod_fd Pi(A2), with four indecomposables S+,S-,P,Q. Its torsion pair is (add(S+,P),add(S-)); all nonzero objects have nonzero Phi image.
claims.derived_warning: Internal Ext in the finite-length A2 category is periodic and differs from ambient Ext. Its bounded derived realization into the ambient Rains category is not fully faithful. Object nonvanishing under Phi does not prove morphism faithfulness.
claims.affine_tests: For p=2 there is an exact sequence 0->W->V+->V-->0 with one-dimensional ends. Hom_A(V+,V-) has dimension 2 precisely for the repeated scalar representation, otherwise 1. Full faithfulness on the two-root generated triangulated category requires distinct characters W and V- and a nonsplit affine extension, hence a 3-dimensional triangular image algebra. These conditions are not proved sufficient.
claims.maximal_numerical_resonance: All roots resonate with nonzero indices on a Zariski-dense subset of the specified genuine elliptic blowup charts in degrees 1 through 6. The integer-index chart has nine E[3] lifts. Not a claim about every nc moduli component.
claims.zigzag: The existing simple-root direct sum has Dynkin zigzag ambient Ext algebra; known formality gives the fixed-category framed MC edge cone. Not relative surface moduli.
not_proved: Actual elliptic A=R/(g-1) generator characters and off-diagonal action matrices
All-q derived equivalence or full faithfulness of natural Phi on the generated triangulated category
A torsion pair on the full Z or the full Rains heart
Relative surface moduli, full moduli coverage, or qgr nonsingularity from resonance
claims.novelty: Exhaustive novelty search and independent peer review have not been performed. Primary Rains and Liu-Wang results are prior inputs, not claimed as new.
proof_safeguards: Irreducibility alone does not imply nonzero structure-sheaf maps are epimorphisms. The new simplicity proof uses nontorsion q and boundary-disjointness.
Rank-one reflexive does not imply line bundle here. The proof uses Rains Proposition 10.13 equality.
Global derived equivalence is not an input to the new rank theorem.
